# The river: an 18 x 12 m plane (world z -3.5..8.5), dark water with ripple dashes painted in a
# palette-exact 72 x 48 texture. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z.
new
add mesh grid --name Water --size 1 --x-subdivisions 6 --y-subdivisions 4 --location 0 -2.5 0
scale 18 12 1
apply --scale
material new Water --base-color 1 1 1
material assign Water
active Water
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Water base-color textures/water.png
shade flat
export water.glb
